warnings: Pile caps on hollow hexagonal piles (Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m.): F1 1.20 x 0.75 x 0.25 on 6 piles, F2 1.65 x 1.20 x 0.30 on 12 piles; top of cap 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม, 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand below. Non-square caps: width_mm is the side drawn horizontal (along x on the S-01 footing plan), depth_mm the other.

main_bar.count is the two-way total of the two printed callouts (F1 10-DB12 + 7-DB12, F2 18-DB12 + 13-DB12); which callout is which direction is not stated beyond the leaders, so both are kept in printed_as. The edge tie 'RB 9 รัดรอบ' is one bar (stirrup.count 1, no spacing).

ST-1: waist 0.15, tread 0.25, riser 0.1833, horizontal run 1.25; foot on a B2 at ระดับดิน, head on a B2 at the floor. On the S-01 plans the stairs are marked ST-01 / ST-02 — this section is titled ST-1 and matches ST-01 (run A to A'''' = 1.25); ST-02 has no section of its own, so nothing is copied to it.
